items.title: Italy Pay in 3 Credit Checks at Klarna, Scalapay, PayPal May Come After November 20 Deadline
items.why: Europe's BNPL affordability rules are tightening; expect US regulators to look at similar checks on pay-over-time features.
items.summary_ai: Italy's credit checks for Pay in 3 products at Klarna, Scalapay and PayPal may begin after a November 20 deadline.
items.take: Europe's BNPL affordability rules are tightening; expect US regulators to look at similar checks on pay-over-time features.
